text:
maya: Heads-up: PRD draft for 'serving runtime change' posted — proposing attention heuristic opt-in + new KV eviction policy (percent-based cold eviction) to reduce memory pressure on A100 pools. Need acceptance criteria, launch gates, and canary plan. Ping @dan @li @sophie. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfcs/serving-attn-evict (draft)
dan: :eyes: skimmed. Need perf targets — e.g., p95 generation latency <= 220ms at 32 tokens vs current 240ms? Also cost goal: <= 0.9x token cost. Can we avoid quality regressions? How do we detect hallucination changes? Suggest eval set + shadow traffic.
li: Agree on shadow traffic + eval. For KV eviction, propose default: `eviction_threshold_pct: 20`, `hot_prefix_time_s: 300`. If we evict too aggressively, prefix re-fetch cost could spike. Also, kernel selection: fallback to quantized kernel for long context > 4096 to save memory. Acceptance criteria: no >5% increase in perplexity on eval set, <2% tail latency regressions.
sophie: Customer ask from AcmeAI: they need predictable latencies for long chat sessions. They'll accept small quality delta if latency is stable. For Dedicated customers, we should expose a knob `eviction_policy: conservative|balanced|aggressive`. For Hosted, default to balanced. Action: include config schema in PRD.
maya: I'll add knob and write canary plan. Quick draft of canary steps:
```
1. Deploy to 5% of hosted real traffic (non-critical orgs)
2. Shadow routing for 20% of dedicated capacity
3. Evaluate: perf, cost, eval QA
4. Rollout 25/50/100 with rollback on regressions
```
What rollback triggers?
dan: Rollback if:
- p95 latency > +10% sustained for 15m
- eval perplexity regresses > 5% or top-level QA failure rate > 1%
- token cost increases > 10% per 24h
Also add telemetry: per-model kernel selection counts, eviction churn metric.
li: Add a spike detector for KV re-population RPS. If eviction causes spike > 2x baseline, rollback early. Also log prefix miss types.
sophie: :thumbsup: sounds good. I'll draft the PRD acceptance checklist. Can someone create the RFC and link here? maya?
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1735556666-serving-runtime-attn-eviction (draft) — reviewers: dan, li, sophie
maya: :rocket: created. Assigning reviewers. I'll sync with customer success re: AcmeAI expectations. Meeting to finalize scope tomorrow 9am PT?
dan: Added to my calendar.
li: I'll prepare the eval harness and baseline numbers before the meeting.
sophie: I'll coordinate Dedicated customer knob and doc changes.
